decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard while disrupting the opponent with spells like Fiery Impulse and Spell Pierce. The deck focuses on casting a high number of instant and sorcery spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability and close out the game with aggressive creatures and burn spells. Utilizing cards like Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise to draw into more resources and maintain tempo, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combo between Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful synergy that allows for board control and creature removal. The deck also includes strong removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt opponent's strategies. Additionally, cards like Bitter Triumph and Fear of Missing Out provide additional value and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and combo interactions.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and overwhelm your opponent with aggressive plays. The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to effectively control the board while also digging through your deck with cards like Opt and Consider to find your key pieces. The inclusion of cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster further enhance your graveyard filling and spell casting capabilities, creating a fast-paced and explosive gameplay style.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game with removal spells and powerful creatures, while utilizing Zur, Eternal Schemer to search for key cards and maintain card advantage. The deck focuses on resource denial, disruption, and incremental advantage to outmaneuver opponents and grind out victories. With a mix of versatile removal, powerful creatures, and land cards that enable flexibility and consistency, the deck aims to outlast opponents and steadily increase its advantage over time.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing various spells and card draw effects to quickly fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, allowing them to be reanimated for consistent damage and pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes versatile removal spells and disruptive cards to control the board and protect the Phoenixes. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise helps to refuel resources and maintain a steady stream of threats. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, leveraging the powerful synergies of the Arclight Phoenix archetype to overwhelm opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Lotus Field and untap it with cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. This allows the player to generate a large amount of mana to cast powerful spells like Pore Over the Pages and Dig Through Time. The deck also includes some control elements with Lightning Strike and creature removal. With the ability to search for specific lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Ketria Triome, this deck aims to assemble its pieces quickly for a powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early in the game with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. It aims to control the board through removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act while also incorporating powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games quickly. The deck also utilizes a mix of land destruction and mana ramp elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain a relentless attack strategy.

The deck aims to utilize the Transmogrify combo to transform Atraxa, Grand Unifier into powerful creatures like Mirrex or Reckoner Bankbuster. The strategy involves careful mana cultivation and disruption of opponent's plans using spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana ramping. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower to control the board. Overall, the focus is on executing the Transmogrify combo efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using Azorius spirits to control the board and tempo of the game. By utilizing cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition to disrupt the opponent's strategy and Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom to boost the spirits' power, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the battlefield. The inclusion of cards like No More Lies and Enduring Curiosity allows for card advantage and disruption, while also providing additional ways to close out the game. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and disruptive strategy.

The key strategy of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and land destruction with Field of Ruin. The deck aims to control the board with creatures like Reckoner Bankbuster and Unstoppable Slasher, while applying pressure with creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Bloodletter of Aclazotz. With the ability to grind out games and outvalue opponents, this deck is focused on maintaining control of the game until it can close out the win.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells, removal, and card advantage while controlling the board. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Supreme Verdict to maintain card advantage and answer threats. The deck also includes lands like Field of Ruin to disrupt the opponent's mana base and control the battlefield. The goal is to outvalue the opponent through efficient removal, counterspells, and card draw, while eventually closing out the game with powerful threats like The Wandering Emperor or Hall of Storm Giants.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly get Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and then use various spells and abilities to bring them back onto the battlefield. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and aggressive, with an emphasis on using cheap spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix ability multiple times in a single turn. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain a strong board presence. The inclusion of spells like Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise helps to cycle through the deck quickly and find key pieces needed for victory.

The main concept of this deck revolves around quickly and efficiently filling up the graveyard with spells and then bringing back Arclight Phoenix to deal damage and close out the game. It utilizes a combination of burn spells, card draw, and graveyard interaction to consistently recur the Phoenix while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Treasure Cruise helps to dig through the deck and find the necessary pieces to enable the Phoenix's return, creating a relentless aggro strategy that aims to overwhelm the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Heartfire Hero and Monastery Swiftspear, backed up by spells like Infuriate and Monstrous Rage to deal extra damage. The deck also includes cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to provide additional threats and reach. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a Companion to provide additional value and consistency. With a low mana curve and a focus on fast-paced aggression, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and finish the game quickly.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay with a mix of low-cost creatures and burn spells. It utilizes Jegantha as a companion for consistency and additional value. The key strategy is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, while using burn spells like Monstrous Rage and Heartfire Hero to finish off the game. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Infuriate help control the board and push for damage, making it a potent aggro deck in the Pioneer format.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly bringing out aggressive creatures and disrupting your opponent's strategy with targeted removal spells and discard effects. By applying pressure early in the game and keeping the opponent on the defensive, this deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can establish a strong board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodletter of Aclazotz provide additional threats that can quickly turn the tide in your favor.
